title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Doctor, I greatly admire your genius. It's my honor to be your guard.

title: Talk 1
original: A man of my experience can tell you'll be a great leader one day, Doctor.

title: Talk 2
original: I have an unusual skin tone, you say? Hah. Just a souvenir from back when I snuck into a biolab, and... Please, I'm joking around.

title: Talk 3
original: I need to wear this scarf, even when I sleep, or else my neck will get cold.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: This face of mine might be a little too exotic for your typical townsfolk. Heh, I tend to draw a curious crowd when I wander.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I'm surprised how polite you are to this old man! Not many besides Durin ask after my health.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: When I go barefoot, I can sense enemies through their vibrations on the ground.

title: Idle
original: Hmm... Snoring is a bad habit. The other rangers will hear you.

title: Onboard
original: I'm Rangers, the Sniper. Call whenever you need me.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Not bad.

title: Added to Squad
original: My turn, is it?

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Good. Let me show you what an old man can do.

title: Depart
original: Let's get going.

title: Begin Operation
original: Prey spotted. Commence operation.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I'm waiting for orders.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: What are your orders?

title: Deployment 1
original: Alright.

title: Deployment 2
original: Got it.

title: In Battle 1
original: Found you!

title: In Battle 2
original: Taste my arrow!

title: 4-star Result
original: Challenge after challenge. Exactly what we wanted. Right, Noir Corne?

title: 3-star Result
original: What a satisfying battle!

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: A few of them got through. I'd call that decent.

title: Operation Failure
original: Oh no, I'm out of breath...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: If you need anything, just say the word.

title: Tap
original: Urgh! Please, leave my tail be...

title: Trust Tap
original: You like me that much, huh? Weird taste, I gotta say.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Doctor, it's been three hours, and the kiddos still clamoring for more of my stories. Talk to them, will ya...? The New Year always makes the young'uns so astonishingly lively. I can't compete with that…

title: Greeting
original: Doctor, how can I help you?

title: Birthday
original: I'm kinda too old to follow what you young'uns may want. But here's a little something I like. This scarf's made out of my favorite material, lightweight but warm. It will keep you cozy when it's cold, Doctor. Happy birthday.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Retirement? Too soon for that. Not while I still eat five buns for breakfast. Once my appetite declines, then—and only then, will I find some place to bask in the sun. But for now, don't you worry.
